title: Freeze checker: disable Git lazy fetch and repository transport execution
outcome: Codex session-6884 High, src/review_freeze.rs:108. Git environment stripping omits GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH. A partial/promisor clone can fetch missing objects during diff, write objects and invoke repository-configured transport (including core.sshCommand). Source-confirmed missing guard; no exploit executed. Disable lazy fetching with a supported fail-closed mechanism and reject unavailable objects.
acceptance: Missing-promisor-object regression with transport sentinel proves no helper runs and no repository objects are written; ordinary complete-repository verification still succeeds.
